column7: Typo – The author's name is corrected from the erroneous appayyā dīkṣita to the historically and orthographically verified appayya dīkṣita.

Typo – Suggested "Print Change": The printed semicolon in the 1957 Apte digitization artificially fractures this semantic unit, generating a false dichotomy. By eliminating the typographic rupture, your unified correction ("The blue water-lily plant") flawlessly re-establishes absolute semantic isomorphism with the intended Sanskrit botanical derivative—perfectly distinguishing the complete blooming organism from both the detached flower (the uncompounded base) and the geographic region (definitions 2 and 3).

column6: The Headword "kuvalayita" should be properly placed just before the word "kuvalayin [ID= 12627]" in the Hierarchical listing of words. This is an actual ERROR in the printed Text, that is not worthy of importation online!
